package.name: so101_hardware_interface_cpp
package.description:
C++/ament_cmake replacement for so101_hardware_interface (the ament_python version). Bridges the real SO-101 Feetech servo bus to ROS 2 by EMBEDDING the Python interpreter and calling LeRobot's SOFollower driver from C++ via the raw CPython C-API -- SOFollower itself is Python-only, so this is the way to use it from a control-critical C++ node without reimplementing the Feetech bus protocol from scratch.
Requires python3-dev (for Python.h / libpython) at build time -- not a rosdep key, install manually: sudo apt install python3-dev Same category of exception as robotpkg-pinocchio: found via CMake's FindPython3, not a package.xml depend tag.
At runtime, point the "venv_site_packages" parameter at the site-packages directory of whatever Python environment has `lerobot` installed (e.g. a `python3 -m venv --system-site-packages` venv built on the SAME system Python ROS was built against, so compiled extensions like torch load correctly under the embedded interpreter).
